description: This is a minimalist nightstand with two drawers. The drawers have sleek, horizontal handles. The nightstand has a simple, boxy design and stands on four short legs, two of which are darker than the others. The top surface is flat and appears to be a single piece. The overall aesthetic is clean and functional, with a neutral color palette that would fit into various bedroom decors. The design is uncluttered, emphasizing practicality and a modern sensibility.
